reviews.review_text:
Brett
Papamoa, New Zealand2052 contributions
1
Great inexpensive rooftop bar, for any size group.
May 2026 • Friends
We needed a venue for a table of 18 to celebrate a big birthday in May 2026, and The View Rooftop on Bùi Viện Street turned out to be perfect. We did book a long way in advance to guarantee such a large table. They offered several set‑menu options at a genuinely great price, and even let us choose between the outdoor terrace and the indoor dining area — we chose the terrace.The rooftop space was beautifully decorated in warm Hoi An mustard tones, with lots of red lanterns creating a festive atmosphere. Service was excellent and very attentive throughout the night. The Saigon skyline views were lovely, though a little distant, and you don’t really see or hear Bùi Viện Street from up there. The terrace bar area is large and became very busy later in the evening, likely because the drink prices are extremely affordable and the cocktails are imaginative and fun. Music was great, and although the elevator to the 9th‑floor rooftop is small and gets busy, it wasn’t a problem.Overall, we made a fantastic choice. The View Rooftop is chilled, social, affordable, and very easy to recommend.

reviews.review_text:
Françoise J
Excideuil, France179 contributions
0
We've been fooled!
Feb 2026 • Couples
We had discovered this rooftop the day before for a drink. No less than 3 waiters had come to our table to encourage us to book for the evening of the next day to admire at midnight, the fireworks of the city given on the occasion of the passage of the new year (Tet). A formula - from memory - at 890d or about thirty euros per person. For this small local fortune; a welcome drink, a platelet of small skewers and spare ribs, a salad, all OFF drink and off dessert. It seemed exorbitant, but we thought: "Let's be crazy! Let's celebrate the Vietnamese New Year! " In the evening we are installed with ... a thimble of a tasteless drink; the famous welcome drink!! (I should have taken a photo if I had imagined the rest) then arrives the famous board... everything is cold! We are told that it is normal because the kitchens are 4 floors below and the time to arrive it has cooled!!! Nevertheless we agree to collect our dishes to warm them up; they come back also cold! The 3rd time was the right one but I might as well say that it was so dry and charred that EVERYTHING was inedible. The icing on the cake is that at 11:30 p.m. customers who have been let up without paying the formula, settle down and order a drink. Result: without having paid the fortune we spent for NOTHING, they benefit from the same show!!!
